name: ION: Mgnovenija vechosti
source: Let's go back many decades to the past, long before the ill-fated bus accident. It was then, under mysterious circumstances, that the amazing pioneer camp "Sovenok" appeared. No one suspects how much fate has changed this mysterious place and what it really is. This is the final chapter in which we will learn how this story began and how it will end.
translation: 让我们回到几十年前，早在那场不幸的公交车事故发生之前。就在那时，在神秘的情况下，令人惊叹的拓荒者营地“Sovenok”出现了。没有人怀疑命运对这个神秘的地方以及它到底是什么产生了多大的改变。这是最后一章，我们将了解这个故事如何开始以及如何结束。
